Marcus — I reviewed BrightWave_DPA_Redlines_20261118.pdf and the annotated order form. Key findings and suggested next steps below.

Executive summary:
- SCCs: BrightWave is asking Redwood to adopt the updated EU SCCs with controller-to-processor modules and the UK addendum. We can sign these, but there are three items to confirm: 1) subprocessors list disclosure cadence (they want quarterly; our standard is notification + 30 days), 2) indemnity language tied to unauthorized access (they added broad language), and 3) encryption-at-rest guarantees for customer uploaded data (we provide at-rest encryption, but keys are KMS-managed — acceptable).
- Processor/Controller role map: the redline inserts obligations that look like joint-controller language in two analytics clauses. Recommend we propose a clarified role map exhibit (short) that states: Redwood = processor for customer data used for inference; BrightWave = controller for customer PII; Redwood may act as controller only for telemetry for product improvement if separately consented or pseudonymized.
- Transfer addendum: propose a one-page transfer impact addendum referencing the EU SCCs + UK Addendum and listing primary processing locations (us-west-2, eu-west-1) and subprocessors. Provide a bulletized evidence pack (SaaS subprocessors list, SOC 2 report link, data flow diagram) rather than substantive clause changes.
- Retention: they want 28 months, we typically retain logs for 36 months depending on product. Suggest a middle ground: 30 months for analytics logs, 12 months for raw request-level logs (redaction possible).

Action items (owners):
- Olga: draft DPA addendum (SCCs + transfer exhibit) + risk memo (due Fri 11/20 EOD).
- Karthik: mark up order form commercial redlines that affect pricing/commitments (due Fri 11/20).
- Laura: confirm that our standard deletion language can be tightened to the 30-month compromise and flag any SLA/incident reporting changes (due Fri 11/20).

Attachments: internal_dpa_notes_olga_20261119.docx (internal notes)

I'll prepare a short summary to send back to Ellen with these options and ask for a quick call if they need tighter timelines.

— Olga

Ellen — thanks for sending the redlines and for the clarity on your requirements. Quick summary and our proposed path forward below.

1) SCCs / transfer: We can adopt the updated EU SCCs and the UK addendum. Our counsel (Olga, cc'd) will prepare a one-page Transfer Addendum that references those SCCs, enumerates processing locations (AWS us-west-2, eu-west-1), and includes a short subprocessors evidence pack. Expect the addendum draft by EOD Friday (11/20). Could you confirm whether BrightWave needs a quarterly subprocessor disclosure or notification + 30 days? We prefer notification + 30 days; if you require quarterly, we'll need to flag resourcing for the compliance cadence.

2) Roles: We agree to a concise Role Map exhibit (processor vs controller) and will add language to the DPA that limits Redwood's controller activities to telemetry/process-improvement only and only on pseudonymized data or with separate consent.

3) Retention: Proposed compromise — 30 months for analytics logs; 12 months for per-request raw logs with the option for BrightWave to request longer retention for specific datasets with written justification. Laura (cc) will confirm the exact deletion clause wording.

4) Commercial/order form: Karthik (cc) will follow up on the specific order-form redlines that affect termination and capacity commitments; we don't see fundamental blockers but will list any commercial exceptions in a short redline memo.

Next steps: 
- Olga to send DPA Transfer Addendum & risk memo (EOD 11/20).
- Karthik to send order form commercial redlines memo (EOD 11/20).
- If BrightWave prefers a single call, propose Tue 11/24 at 09:00 PT — Marcus, Ellen, Tom, Olga, Karthik, Laura.
